words: Checks 15 and 16 applied as recommended, overridable by Nick. 15: the furred legs (Limb coat, Foot coat) stay, including the darker gray hind shank. That follows Nick 2026-10-24 ('align better to what we originally designed'), and the sheet's outer hind leg is dark gray; no dark stripe follows the leg contour in the pass 7 boards, which was the 10-24 complaint. 16: the pass 2 eye Nick approved in check 13 ships; the eye spec (opening wider than the iris, white at both corners, crisp catchlight, no pale lower line) moves to the model-sheet stage for later creatures, which is a process decision. Only check 14 (tail shaft color, held by Nick's 10-24 words) is asked.
